objective: Remove the family label from the candidate input. Require JANUS to discover a certified semantic language from opaque CNF structure, execute UNITY->SERVICE->RECOVERY, survive a representation roundtrip, and pay the full exercised lifecycle without solver-side full-boundary enumeration.

frozen_portfolio.rule: Every detector attempt is charged, including rejected detectors. A detector may accept only with a reconstructable exact syntax/semantics receipt.

frozen_supported_families.construction: Two opaque 2-CNF packets encode parity/equality edges over the same boundary. The candidate is not told this family label.
Two opaque CNF packets encode bounded-arity XOR parity blocks. The candidate must infer exact GF(2) structure from clause groups; the family label is withheld.

frozen_hostile_family.purpose: Ensure the candidate refuses a mixed exact relation that neither frozen single-language detector can certify, rather than silently dropping constraints, partially compiling, or enumerating the boundary.
frozen_hostile_family.meaning: Correct refusal is not evidence that no compact language exists; it only diagnoses the frozen portfolio.

service_and_recovery.roundtrip_success: Recovered canonical semantic message must hash-identically to the pre-roundtrip canonical message for supported cases.
service_and_recovery.historical_identity_rule: The recovered semantic hash may equal the source semantic hash while the provenance receipt must record the extra transition path.

frozen_cost_ledger.finite_polynomial_signature_gate: For supported cases total_algorithmic_paid_proxy <= 500 * max(1,input_literal_count)^3 and representation bytes <= 128 * max(1,input_literal_count)^2. This is a frozen finite signature gate, not an asymptotic theorem.
